items.name: NCI Genomic Data Commons
items.desc: Harmonized genomic and clinical data, including TCGA lung adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, with case filtering, analysis tools and file download.

items.name: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics
items.desc: Open-source portal for exploring cancer genomics datasets, maintained by a multi-institutional team that includes Princess Margaret Cancer Centre.

items.name: ICGC ARGO Data Platform
items.desc: International Cancer Genome Consortium data on GRCh38 with linked clinical data; controlled data needs DACO approval. Hosted by the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research.

items.name: ICGC ARGO
items.desc: Consortium programme aiming to analyze specimens from 100,000 cancer patients with high-quality clinical data.

items.name: European Genome-phenome Archive
items.desc: Permanent archive for sensitive genetic, phenotypic and clinical research data, released through data access committees.

items.name: DepMap Portal
items.desc: Cancer dependency data (CRISPR screens, omics, drug sensitivity) for more than 2,000 cancer models, including lung cancer cell lines.

items.name: LungMAP
items.desc: Open molecular and cellular atlas of the human and mouse lung, with single-cell, spatial, imaging and multi-omic data on development and disease.

items.name: TRACERx Lung
items.desc: Prospective NSCLC cohort tracking how tumours evolve from diagnosis to relapse, led at UCL and funded mainly by Cancer Research UK.

items.name: Proteomic Data Commons
items.desc: Open cancer proteomics data from CPTAC and other programmes, queryable by web interface or API, with analysis tools.

items.name: CPTAC
items.desc: NCI Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium, which generates proteogenomic data on tumours including lung adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma.

items.name: CPTAC genomic data at the GDC
items.desc: Where CPTAC genomic data sit (GDC) versus its proteomic data (PDC), with the lung studies and access levels listed.

items.name: CPTAC-LUAD imaging collection
items.desc: CT, MR, PET and slide images for 244 lung adenocarcinoma subjects, linked to clinical, genomic and proteomic data.

items.name: PRIDE Archive
items.desc: EMBL-EBI repository of mass spectrometry proteomics datasets.

items.name: Human Protein Atlas: lung adenocarcinoma
items.desc: Survival-associated genes from TCGA, CPTAC tumour-versus-normal protein levels, and antibody-based protein profiling.

items.name: Human Protein Atlas: lung squamous cell carcinoma
items.desc: The same atlas chapter for squamous cell carcinoma of the lung.

items.name: Cancer Trials Canada
items.desc: Bilingual national search for cancer trials in Canada, run by the Canadian Cancer Society with Q-CROC and OncoQuébec.

items.name: Health Canada Clinical Trials Database
items.desc: Health Canada's list of authorized drug and biologic trials, searchable by condition, status and location.

items.name: Canadian Cancer Trials Group
items.desc: National cooperative group running treatment, supportive care and prevention trials, with a thoracic disease site committee.

items.name: Ontario Health: lung cancer guidelines
items.desc: Cancer Care Ontario's lung cancer guidance documents, each marked current, archived or in review.

items.name: Ontario Lung Screening Program
items.desc: Organized screening for higher-risk people aged 55 to 74 with at least 20 years of daily smoking; referral by a provider or directly to a participating hospital.

items.name: Canadian Partnership Against Cancer: lung screening
items.desc: Overview of provincial organized lung screening programmes, pilots and standards.

items.name: NCCN Guidelines: NSCLC
items.desc: Current NCCN guidelines for early, locally advanced and metastatic NSCLC; a free account is needed to read them.

items.name: ESMO: lung and chest tumours
items.desc: European guidelines for early and metastatic NSCLC, small cell lung cancer and mesothelioma.

items.name: ASCO living guideline: stage IV NSCLC without driver alterations
items.desc: Continually revised treatment recommendations based on ongoing review of randomized trials.

items.name: NCI PDQ: NSCLC treatment (health professional)
items.desc: The National Cancer Institute's evidence summary on NSCLC treatment for clinicians.

items.name: IASLC Staging Project
items.desc: Development of the 10th edition TNM staging for lung cancer, thymic tumours and mesothelioma, with 9th edition resources.

items.name: Lung Cancer Canada: research program
items.desc: Breathe Forward Award, Geoffrey Ogram Memorial Research Grant, Lung Ambition Awards and Give a Breath Research Award.

items.name: Canadian Cancer Society: funding opportunities
items.desc: Open and upcoming competitions, including Challenge Grants, Emerging Scholar grants and training awards.

items.name: Terry Fox Research Institute
items.desc: New Investigator Awards, New Frontiers Program Project Grants, technology development awards and investigator-initiated clinical trials.

items.name: Canadian Institutes of Health Research
items.desc: Project and Foundation Grant programmes, training awards, strategic initiatives and the New Frontiers in Research Fund.

items.name: Lung Health Foundation
items.desc: Ontario's lung health charity; lists its research awards and posts calls when open.

items.name: LUNGevity Foundation
items.desc: Translational Research and Career Development Awards in early detection and new therapies.

items.name: Lung Cancer Research Foundation
items.desc: Annual awards including ALK-positive, small cell, prevention and early detection, and resistance grants.

items.name: IASLC research grants
items.desc: Career Advancement, Adi F. Gazdar Fellowship, Young Investigator and translational thoracic oncology grants.

items.name: GO2 for Lung Cancer: research grants
items.desc: Young Innovators Team Awards, Young Investigators Program and other lung cancer research awards.

items.name: American Lung Association
items.desc: Lung Cancer Discovery, Catalyst and Innovation Awards, among others.

items.name: Cancer Research UK: lung cancer research
items.desc: Overview of CRUK's lung cancer research portfolio, including TRACERx.

items.name: Lung Cancer Canada
items.desc: Canadian charity for the lung cancer community: support groups, peer support, healthcare navigation and a free patient guide.

items.name: Canadian Cancer Society: lung cancer
items.desc: Causes, screening, diagnosis, staging, treatment, supportive care and statistics.

items.name: GO2 for Lung Cancer
items.desc: Free HelpLine, peer support programmes, education and advocacy.

items.name: LUNGevity Foundation
items.desc: Helpline, peer mentoring, online communities and resources for survivors and caregivers.

items.name: National Cancer Institute: lung cancer
items.desc: Patient information on types, treatment, screening, research advances and supportive care.

items.name: bioRxiv: cancer biology
items.desc: Recent cancer biology preprints.

items.name: medRxiv: oncology
items.desc: Recent clinical oncology preprints, with alert sign-up.

items.name: Research Square
items.desc: Preprints and manuscripts under journal review.

items.name: Zenodo
items.desc: Open repository for citable datasets, software and presentations, run by CERN and OpenAIRE.

items.name: OSF
items.desc: Center for Open Science platform for preregistration, preprints and research records.
